paper.title_en: Transformers with Physics-Informed Encodings and Simulation-Based Inference for Robust Detection of Eccentric Binary Black Holes in Pulsar Timing Array Data
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) provide a unique window into nanohertz gravitational waves (GWs), but extracting astrophysical parameters from noisy, long-baseline timing residuals remains computationally challenging with traditional Bayesian techniques due to the high dimensionality of the parameter space, complex and correlated noise models, and the cost of repeated likelihood evaluations. We introduce a Transformer with a physics-informed positional-encoding framework for the efficient inference of eccentric binary black holes in relativistic orbits from PTA data. Our approach embeds analytical GW phase evolution directly into the model through structured positional encodings, enabling the network to learn physically meaningful representations from raw PTA timing residuals. We then use generative models, including discrete and continuous conditional normalizing flows, to infer posterior distributions within a simulation-based inference framework. Across a range of signal-to-noise ratios, the proposed method achieves improved accuracy, sharper posteriors, and faster inference compared to physics-agnostic baselines. While presented for deterministic white-noise signals, the modular framework readily generalizes to realistic PTA analyses incorporating red noise and additional components. This work highlights the potential of physics-aware deep learning models as scalable alternatives to conventional inference pipelines for next-generation PTA datasets.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将物理信息驱动的Transformer位置编码与基于模拟的推理（离散与连续条件归一化流）结合，用于从脉冲星计时阵列数据中推断偏心双黑洞参数，属于PTA主题；方法框架明确、可扩展，且给出了与物理无关基线的比较结果，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 结合物理信息编码与基于模拟推理的Transformer用于脉冲星计时阵列数据中偏心双黑洞的稳健探测
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）为探测纳赫兹引力波（GWs）提供了独特的窗口，但从含噪的长基线计时残差中提取天体物理参数，由于参数空间的高维性、复杂且相关的噪声模型以及重复似然评估的代价，用传统贝叶斯技术仍然在计算上具有挑战性。我们引入了一个带有物理信息位置编码框架的Transformer，用于从PTA数据中高效推断相对论轨道上的偏心双黑洞。我们的方法通过结构化的位置编码将解析的引力波相位演化直接嵌入模型，使网络能够从原始PTA计时残差中学习具有物理意义的表示。随后，我们在基于模拟的推理框架内使用生成模型，包括离散和连续的条件归一化流，来推断后验分布。在一系列信噪比下，与物理无关的基线相比，所提出的方法实现了更高的精度、更尖锐的后验以及更快的推理。虽然本文是针对确定性白噪声信号提出的，但这一模块化框架可以容易地推广到包含红噪声和其他成分的实际PTA分析中。这项工作凸显了物理感知深度学习模型作为下一代PTA数据集传统推理流程的可扩展替代方案的潜力。
